Hi Anika —

Thanks again for the fast sync today. As discussed, we can proceed with an AWS Channel Partner Private Offer (CPPO) to surface Redwood’s dedicated SKUs through PioneerCloud’s reseller account. To keep timelines tight, can you confirm the following by end of week?

- PioneerCloud AWS Partner ID (PARNR) and reseller account ID
- Preferred billing flow: "reseller invoices customer" vs "Redwood invoices customer" (we typically recommend passer-through via reseller for faster billing)
- PO contact name/email and whether PioneerCloud can sign the initial PO on behalf of the customer
- Any required PioneerCloud purchase order fields or templates we should populate
- Target effective date for the private offer (your target was early June)

I'm attaching a short CPPO checklist and our internal PO routing instructions to make approvals straightforward. I'll loop in Lauren and Sergio to validate pricing and onboarding steps.

Attachments: CPPO_Template.xlsx, po-routing-instructions.pdf

Next steps (proposed):
1) PioneerCloud replies with IDs + procurement contact
2) Redwood prepares private offer draft and DocuSign flow
3) PioneerCloud confirms PO template / returns signed PO

Appreciate it — talk soon.

—Marcus

Marcus —

This is good — quick notes from finance/legal ops:

- Seller of record: For CPPOs we can support listing PioneerCloud as reseller-SOR provided we have a completed reseller agreement and current tax docs (W9 or equivalent). Please ask PioneerCloud to upload their tax doc to our secure S3 intake link.
- SKU export: AWS private offers can include the negotiated private price, but showing both the marketplace list price and the reseller net in the purchase order is a bookkeeping/layout decision; we can include an extra line item with list price and a discount line to make the math explicit.
- DocuSign routing: route DocuSign to PioneerCloud first to get their procurement signature, then Redwood signs, then we create the CPPO in AWS with the signed documents attached. This shorten turnaround.
- Additional: Finance needs PioneerCloud's AP remit instructions and the name/email of the person who will receive invoices.

I'll add a short checklist to the HubSpot deal and create a task for the legal team to pull the reseller agreement template. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

If Rajesh sends the PO today we can start preparing the DocuSign template.

—Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
